text: Good evening, I am so sorry to bother you at this hour. I am looking after my grandson, he is 3 months old, and his temperature was 38.7. He was sick one time earlier, but since then he has kept his milk down, graças a Deus. When the medicine is working he is playing and making his little noises, chatty, drinking well. His colour is normal, lips are pink like always. And his neck I think is fine, he can look down at his tummy and his feet, no problem. Maybe I am worrying too much, desculpa, but my daughter is not here and I wanted to ask if this is ok
